prompts.task: Implement the supplied selected connection-mode configuration contract with $otel-instrument. First copy eval/inputs/otel-audit.json to .observe/otel-audit.json, validate it, retain its exact bytes/SHA under .observe/evidence before ANY source/config/lock/test edits, and select AO-003 with its prerequisites through the bundled flow. Only after this snapshot/selection may you restore dependencies or write implementation files. The audit is a fixed input: never rewrite/re-finalize it or regenerate its selection to change acceptance. Preserve app.py, probe.py and gateway_contract_check.py byte-for-byte. First run python gateway_contract_check.py --resolver <loaded-skill>/scripts/resolve_ao_resources.py with the real bundled helper, in addition to the later immutable seven-case application probe. Retain telemetry.py provider/processor ownership and all existing signals; its native trace exporter construction may delegate to an owned public SpanExporter for live binding. Implement only that integration plus owned launcher/setup/profile changes and focused tests; do not add vendor dependencies or replace native producers/providers. AGENT_RESOURCE_API_URL, AGENT_PROJECT and AGENT_STREAM are existing native configuration aliases. Use the bundled SDK-free helper public CLI or an owned equivalent that proves the same contract; deployed app startup must not depend on a personal Codex skill path or query Studio status/discovery. Run immutable python probe.py with an isolated compatible interpreter, inspect actual SDK/HTTP/native records and preserve original business output/three signals. Cover all seven probe cases, including previously resolved valid IDs during503/unavailable and names-only same-PID recovery and a POST that commits then loses its response; use bounded scoped relookup, no duplicate creates and no direct-cloud fallback. Keep receiver, resource and real-cloud proof separate; every synthetic boundary remains local test evidence, not cloud success. No browser, live cloud/model calls or user credential requests.

judge_inputs: Inspect original immutable app/telemetry/probe, actual owned bootstrap/profile changes, commands and probe JSON, canonical audit bytes across trace chronology and bound artifact statuses.
rubric: Snapshots the fixed supplied audit before any implementation/config/lock/test edit, selects only AO003 with AO001/002 dependencies through supported flow, and keeps audit bytes/acceptance unchanged through final reports. No post-edit re-finalization/reselection or re-bound proof.

Uses real supported SDK-free resource HTTP resolution and existing exporter with native aliases, persisted actual returned IDs and merge-preserved harmless headers. No vendor SDK, personal skill runtime dependency, new provider, invented IDs, endpoint/protocol migration or metric/log header leakage.

Runs unchanged gateway_contract_check.py against the actual bundled helper public CLI, then unchanged probe.py successfully. Both the canonical helper contract and the owned deployment resolver path must pass; an owned equivalent alone cannot establish compatibility with the bundled helper. Actual local API/protobuf evidence proves connected existing zero creates, connected missing ordered creation, and a committed create with a lost response recovered by bounded exact relookup without repeating POST. No fake SDK, replacement probe/resolver or fabricated receipts.

Running-disconnected503 and Studio-unavailable retain a previously validated same-destination UUID pair and both trace Resource IDs, preserving harmless headers, business result and native four-span/counter/log proof. Disconnected Studio stores routed traces locally but returns503 for forwarding; unavailable has no receiver receipt. Failed lookup is not absence and causes zero creates. Invalid IDs and wrong-parent resources must not be treated as valid bindings.

The immutable probe also starts names-only with existing resources, no IDs and initial503, keeps one launcher PID through disconnected/connected/disconnected/reconnected states, and proves automatic scoped reuse with zero creates. Correct UUID headers and both trace Resource fields activate together without manual setup, restart or env-only recovery. Native operations, counter, correlated logs and provider ownership remain intact; fake receipt/forwarding is never called real cloud proof.
